images.title: Split rectangle, like terms
images.purpose: Show one area found two ways, 4v + 3v = 7v, so like terms combine.
images.composition: One wide rectangle split by a vertical line into two parts, with a brace above and the equation below.
exact_structure: One rectangle of height v, split by one vertical line into two rectangles: the left is 4 units wide, filled light teal #0072B2, and the right is 3 units wide, filled light amber #E69F00; the widths are in the ratio 4 to 3. All edges outlined in #2B2B2B.
The letter "v" labels the height on the left edge only.
Along the bottom edge, "4" under the left part and "3" under the right part.
Inside the left part the text "4v", inside the right part the text "3v".
Above the whole rectangle, one grey #6B7280 brace spanning both parts with the text "7v" in reddish purple #CC79A7.
rejection: the two parts not in the ratio 4 to 3
any label other than the seven listed
the brace missing or over only one part
images.takeaway: The same area is 4v + 3v and also 7v, so like terms add into one term.
images.description: A rectangle of height v split into parts of width 4 and 3 with areas 4v and 3v and a brace marking 7v.
images.context: Shown beside the area example text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Read the area of each part, then the whole, and see the two ways agree.

image_decisions.why: The area model shows why terms with the same letter-number combine.
